_why: Remote task rendering is a revisioned stream, not a sequence of session-list reloads. The first follower receives one atomic history snapshot and subsequent UI activity arrives as exact-base patches over a resumable, acknowledged transport. A gap must be explicit and recover through a replacement snapshot; silently accepting it can leave a phone spinning forever or omit tool output.

readFirst._why: Saved history must render while provider initialization proceeds. Read results and final follows are generation-scoped; only the final atomic snapshot establishes a live cursor.
readFirst.capture: saved read starts independently of resume and completes before the final ordered follow cut
readFirst.cancelledView: release the read lane while admitted startup drains and cleans up
readFirst.lateRead: discard after replacement or final snapshot
readFirst.activeItems: engine event-pump capture at source cursor
readFirst.coveredMessageIds: complete message UUIDs and persisted block identities suppress notification deltas arriving after their hydrated row
readFirst.reasoningIdentity: persisted messageId allocated when reasoning starts; filtering empty blocks or aborting tools cannot change it
readFirst.liveTurnIdentity: authoritative core turnId on item, delta, and raw progress frames; submissionId fallback is normalized by the active turn binding
readFirst.coveredToolResults: turnId and toolUseId pairs suppress already persisted tool lifecycle and progress; file changes remain visible
readFirst.originalHistoryFence: accepted rollout revision is unchanged across flush, original read, and live capture; eight moving captures return an explicit busy error
readFirst.liveTurnStatus: both provider-free history and full follow overlay running from already-owned active turn leases; explicit terminal status remains authoritative and inactive recovery stays interrupted

snapshot._why: `session:follow` projects the engine history without a sessionId, but the phone's history envelope requires it; a missing key made the phone discard the whole snapshot and spin on an empty transcript.

taskStream.snapshotCut: engine history revision plus every later or non-engine host event exactly once

transport.reconnect: resume and replay every unacknowledged envelope
transport.clientMutationCommit: persist the processed sequence after admission or a correlated rejection; a rejected request cannot block later sequences
transport.businessAcceptance: message_accepted follows chat:send turn admission, independently of client_ack

businessRecovery.unknownOutcome: after replay, an admitted request with no retained outcome remains user-recoverable and is never automatically resent

transport.controlReceipts: coalesced cumulative ACKs bypass the engine request queue
transport.chunkData: base64 of the logical message UTF-8 bytes, with one sequence shared by all parts
transport.partialAcknowledgement: retain the logical envelope until all fragments and its cumulative receipt are acknowledged; resume only skips fragments the receiving peer reports it still retains
transport.clientCursorRegression: outcome unknown; do not renumber or replay mutations automatically
transport.replayWriter: one streaming batch preserves sequence without exhausting the physical-frame queue

interactionVisibility._why: A peer following one session used to be silently excluded from every other session's permission/elicit frames, so a desktop turn blocked on approval was invisible on the phone until the user opened that session.

connectionReadiness._why: Provider model catalogs and command discovery must not block the transport hello, session catalog, or mutation admission.
connectionReadiness.composer: independent background refresh; errors retain the connection and existing values
connectionReadiness.engineRecovery: acquire the single engine connection before pinning requests; invalidate every prior follow epoch

frames._why: Decode-compatibility fixtures: the phone's decoder must accept exactly these host frames. A missing required key once made the phone discard the whole snapshot and spin forever.
